name: workspace-tabs
title: Workspace Tabs
description: Open documents and conversations in shared accessible tabs. Custom leading content, toolbar/footer slots, separate close buttons, unsaved indicators, contained scrolling and three surfaces work with ordinary keyboard navigation.
example:
<WorkspaceTabs
  items={openDocuments}
  selectedId={activeId}
  onSelectionChange={setActiveId}
  onClose={closeDocument}
  onNewTab={createDocument}
  renderPanel={document => <DocumentEditor id={document.id} />}
/>
